title: UpgradeFindings
description: What a v1-v4 pact conversion could not carry across exactly, and what it decided on the author's behalf (spec.md §8.4). Returned by 'upgrade/pact' alongside the converted contract (protocol spec §8.4) so 'pact upgrade' can show its work. An empty list is the claim that the conversion was exact.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: One spot in the source pact where the conversion lost something or made a judgement call.

code.description: Open vocabulary; an unknown code is displayed, never dispatched on. Codes are listed in spec.md §8.4.

kind.description: 'lossy' means the contract now says less than the pact did; 'judgement' means the converter chose between readings that the pact did not distinguish; 'note' means neither, and is worth reading anyway.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the *source pact*, not the converted contract — the author is looking at the file they wrote.

message.description: Prose, addressed to the author of the pact. Says what was decided and what to check, not what the converter's internals did.

target.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the converted contract, where the source construct ended up, when there is such a place.
